name: Ride Or Die
source:
A story set in the theme park of Clover’s Island! When your ferry to the mainland goes down, you’re forced into an extended vacation as the park employees show their true colors.

Escape the island alive by charming your way into the hearts of your hosts –the “helpful” and “friendly” staff.

[From [url=https://teammirrorhouse.itch.io/ride-or-die-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
